english.title: Holder of scrap metal dealers collector's licence fail to display copy of licence in business vehicle so it can be read
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a scrap metal dealer holding a collector's licence, failed to display a copy of the licence on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), being used in the course of your business, in a manner which enabled it easily to be read by a person outside the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(3), (4) and (5) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.
